#!/usr/bin/env bash
# Quality gate for the staged diff, called from .githooks/pre-commit.
#
# Two tiers of finding:
#   BLOCK - must never reach a commit. Exits non-zero.
#   WARN  - worth telling the developer about, but not worth blocking on.
#
# Blocking rules (checked in every non-binary file):
#   * unresolved merge-conflict markers (<<<<<<< / ======= / >>>>>>>)
# Blocking rules (checked in JS/TS-like source files only):
#   * a `debugger;` statement
#
# Warning rules (checked in source files, see SOURCE_EXT_RE below):
#   * console.log(...) / console.debug(...) calls
#   * TODO / FIXME comments
#
# Only lines *added* by the staged diff are inspected, so pre-existing issues
# elsewhere in the tree don't block unrelated commits.
#
# Way out: a developer who has judged the risk and wants to proceed anyway
# can set QUALITY_GATE_OVERRIDE=1. Blocking findings are still printed, but
# downgraded so they no longer fail the commit.
#
# This script and its test file are excluded from scanning: they legitimately
# contain the trigger strings (e.g. "debugger;", conflict markers) as pattern
# definitions and test fixtures, not as real cleanup issues.
set -euo pipefail

self_path="scripts/enforce-quality.sh"
test_path="test/quality-gate.test.mjs"

# JS/TS-like source files, where "debugger;" and "console.log(" are meaningful.
js_ext_re='\.(js|mjs|cjs|jsx|ts|tsx)$'
# Broader set of source files where TODO/FIXME comments are worth flagging.
source_ext_re='\.(js|mjs|cjs|jsx|ts|tsx|sh|bash|py|rb|go|java|c|cc|cpp|h|hpp)$'

block_count=0
warn_count=0

report_block() {
  local file="$1" line="$2" message="$3"
  block_count=$((block_count + 1))
  printf '[quality-gate] BLOCK %s:%s: %s\n' "$file" "$line" "$message"
}

report_warn() {
  local file="$1" line="$2" message="$3"
  warn_count=$((warn_count + 1))
  printf '[quality-gate] WARN  %s:%s: %s\n' "$file" "$line" "$message"
}

check_added_line() {
  local file="$1" line="$2" content="$3"

  if [[ "$content" =~ ^\<\<\<\<\<\<\<[[:space:]]?.*$ ]] \
    || [[ "$content" =~ ^=======$ ]] \
    || [[ "$content" =~ ^\>\>\>\>\>\>\>[[:space:]]?.*$ ]]; then
    report_block "$file" "$line" "unresolved merge-conflict marker"
    return
  fi

  if [[ "$file" =~ $js_ext_re ]]; then
    if [[ "$content" =~ (^|[^.[:alnum:]_])debugger[[:space:]]*\; ]]; then
      report_block "$file" "$line" "debugger statement"
    fi
    if [[ "$content" =~ console\.(log|debug)\( ]]; then
      report_warn "$file" "$line" "console.log/debug left in code"
    fi
  fi

  if [[ "$file" =~ $source_ext_re ]]; then
    if [[ "$content" =~ (TODO|FIXME) ]]; then
      report_warn "$file" "$line" "TODO/FIXME comment added"
    fi
  fi
}

current_file=""
current_line=0

while IFS= read -r diff_line; do
  case "$diff_line" in
    "diff --git "*)
      current_file=""
      ;;
    "+++ /dev/null")
      current_file=""
      ;;
    "+++ b/"*)
      current_file="${diff_line#+++ b/}"
      ;;
    "@@ "*)
      hunk="${diff_line#@@ }"
      new_part="${hunk#*+}"
      new_part="${new_part%% *}"
      current_line="${new_part%%,*}"
      ;;
    "+"*)
      content="${diff_line#+}"
      if [[ -n "$current_file" ]]; then
        check_added_line "$current_file" "$current_line" "$content"
      fi
      current_line=$((current_line + 1))
      ;;
    *)
      ;;
  esac
done < <(git diff --cached --unified=0 --no-color -- . ":(exclude)$self_path" ":(exclude)$test_path")

if [[ "$warn_count" -gt 0 ]]; then
  printf '[quality-gate] %d warning(s) found.\n' "$warn_count"
fi

if [[ "$block_count" -gt 0 ]]; then
  if [[ "${QUALITY_GATE_OVERRIDE:-}" == "1" ]]; then
    printf '[quality-gate] %d blocking finding(s) found, but QUALITY_GATE_OVERRIDE=1 is set - allowing commit.\n' "$block_count"
    exit 0
  fi
  printf '[quality-gate] %d blocking finding(s) found. Fix them, or set QUALITY_GATE_OVERRIDE=1 to proceed anyway.\n' "$block_count"
  exit 1
fi

exit 0

    "+++ /dev/null")
      current_file=""
      ;;
    "+++ b/"*)
      current_file="${diff_line#+++ b/}"
      ;;
    "@@ "*)
      hunk="${diff_line#@@ }"
      new_part="${hunk#*+}"
      new_part="${new_part%% *}"
      current_line="${new_part%%,*}"
      ;;
    "+"*)
      content="${diff_line#+}"
      if [[ -n "$current_file" ]]; then
        check_added_line "$current_file" "$current_line" "$content"
      fi
      current_line=$((current_line + 1))
      ;;
    *)
      ;;
  esac
done < <(git diff --cached --unified=0 --no-color -- . ":(exclude)$self_path" ":(exclude)$test_path")

if [[ "$warn_count" -gt 0 ]]; then
  printf '[quality-gate] %d warning(s) found.\n' "$warn_count"
fi

if [[ "$block_count" -gt 0 ]]; then
  if [[ "${QUALITY_GATE_OVERRIDE:-}" == "1" ]]; then
    printf '[quality-gate] %d blocking finding(s) found, but QUALITY_GATE_OVERRIDE=1 is set - allowing commit.\n' "$block_count"
    exit 0
  fi
  printf '[quality-gate] %d blocking finding(s) found. Fix them, or set QUALITY_GATE_OVERRIDE=1 to proceed anyway.\n' "$block_count"
  exit 1
fi

exit 0
